title: Normalized blowup and its structural morphism
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $J$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on $X$. Form its ordinary blowup $B=\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)$ with canonical morphism $b:B	o X$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Let $B^
u$ be the disjoint union of the function-field normalizations of the reduced irreducible components of $B$, with its canonical map $
u_B:B^
u	o B$ [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. Define the normalized blowup of $X$ along $J$ to be $\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)^
u=B^
u$, with structural morphism $b\circ
u_B$ to $X$. In particular this is the normalized blowup for a coherent ideal on a reduced toric scheme. The empty scheme gives the empty blowup and empty normalization.

source.place: Expose VIII, 2.2.1 (normalization) and 2.2.3 (normalized blowup). The published definitions extend the same componentwise construction to arbitrary schemes; on reduced noetherian schemes they are the source construction.
